nl.title: Mixed content (HTTP op HTTPS) oplossen na CyberPanel-SSL
nl.excerpt: Mixed content (HTTP op HTTPS) oplossen na CyberPanel-SSL: gerichte diagnose en fix-stappen van TripleZero iT, met controles.
nl.bodyHtml:
Na HTTPS blijven mixed content-waarschuwingen als CSS/JS/afbeeldingen hard gecodeerd als http:// staan.

Oplossen

  1. Force HTTPS op serverniveau.
  2. Zet site-URL in CMS naar https.
  3. Zoek/vervang http-assets in database (voorzichtig, met backup).
  4. Controleer CDN/externe embeds op https.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: HTTPS forceren; LiteSpeed Cache.

en.title: Mixed content (HTTP on HTTPS) oplossen after CyberPanel-SSL
en.excerpt: CyberPanel: select website, correct module (SSL/DNS/Email/Files/Backup), purge OLS cache.
en.bodyHtml:
In CyberPanel select the website first. For “Mixed content (HTTP on HTTPS) oplossen after CyberPanel-SSL” then open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — depending on the task.

Preparation

  • CyberPanel URL + login
  • Domain name

Steps

  1. Sign in to CyberPanel (port 8090 or welcome link).
  2. Go to Websites and open the correct domain.
  3. Choose the module: SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager, Databases or Backup.
  4. Apply the change and save.
  5. Purge OpenLiteSpeed cache if the site shows old content.
  6. On 500/white screen: open Error Logs for that website.

Verify

  • Change visible on the live URL
  • No new errors in the logs

Tip: Note old DNS/SSL values before you save.

Note: Selecting the wrong website changes another site’s production.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: CyberPanel login, SSL, OLS cache.
